notes: In this update, we completely refactored the Pro license activation interface into a sleek, standalone workspace to provide a cleaner, unoccluded user experience, while also adding a new 'View License Status' option in the settings menu that allows you to accurately track your initial activation date and remaining validity. Additionally, we fixed a bug that caused the activation timestamp to incorrectly reset upon app restarts, and further polished the activation UI for flawless visual compatibility across both light and dark modes.
